name: 2 in 1 Snakes & ladder and Ludo Combo
short_description:
Get ready for double the fun with this 2-in-1 classic board game set!
This game set includes two separate game boards for Snakes & Ladders and Ludo, so no flipping is needed and more friends can join the fun at once.
Easy to set up, fun to play, and great for kids aged 6 and above!

name: Bee Blossom Stacker
short_description: Bright, colourful and full of fun, the Bee Blossom Stacker features six flower-shaped drums that toddlers can stack and arrange in endless combinations. The adorable bee perched on top of the tallest flower adds a delightful finishing touch. This toy helps develop fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination and an understanding of size and sequence. Perfect for inspiring creativity and playtime exploration!

name: DIY Wrist Band Kit
short_description:
Make Special Wrist Bands For Your Loved ones!
Let your child’s creativity shine with the Funskool DIY Wrist Band Kit! Perfect for kids aged 5 and above, this engaging craft kit offers hours of fun as they create 8 colourful and stylish wristbands using wooden dials, stickers, beads and cords. Make Rakhi, friendship bands or a wrist band for family and friends. Whether it’s for a playdate, birthday party, or just a rainy-day activity, this kit encourages imaginative play and personal expression. No glue, no mess—just peel, stick, and design!

name: Finger Painting Space Explorer
short_description:
Painting without a brush can be so much fun! Let the colour fest begin!
Get ready to explore the galaxy with your fingers! The Funskool Finger Painting – Space Explorers kit is an exciting and creative way for kids to paint without a brush. Specially designed for little artists aged 3 and up, this activity set comes with glow-in-the-dark finger paints that bring your child’s space creations to life—even in the dark! With 10 beautifully illustrated activity and design sheets, kids can express their creativity while building fine motor skills. The included display frame lets your child showcase their artwork proudly. It’s messy, sensory fun with a cosmic twist!

name: Harry Potter Perplexus Prophecy
short_description: You’ll need a powerful spell to find your way out of this Prophecy! Enter the world of Harry Potter and challenge yourself to a maze game as difficult as Professor McGonagall’s tests! Much like Harry Potter, you’ll face a considerable amount of obstacles as you begin your quest. Themed in the world of Harry Potter, this maze game is a perfect addition for fans of the Harry Potter books, movies and puzzles!

name: Hello Kitty Coin Bank
short_description: Turn saving into a fun and creative experience with Hello Kitty! Personalize your coin bank with your own artistic touch and enjoy watching your savings grow while building a positive habit every day.

name: Hello Kitty Weaving Beads
short_description: Craft vibrant Hello Kitty designs through creative bead weaving! Explore exciting colour combinations, build unique patterns, and create stylish accessories that showcase your imagination while turning every piece into something truly special.

name: Ice Cream Shop
short_description: It’s ice cream time, kids! Fun Ice Cream Shop lets kids have a whale of a time with ice cream – they can make ice cream with the colourful dough, moulds and extruder. They can set up a shop and sell ice cream cones as well. Kids can display their delicious ice creams and cakes on a snazzy stand. Well, the Fun Ice Cream Shop is all set to be inaugurated!

name: India Map Wooden Puzzles 24 Pieces
short_description:
Turn playtime into a journey across India—where every piece tells a story!
Make learning geography fun and interactive with this beautifully illustrated India Map Wooden Puzzle! Designed especially for young explorers, this 24-piece puzzle introduces children to the states and union territories of India in an engaging, hands-on way

name: Iron Hook
short_description: Pull, Lift, and rescue with unstoppable power featuring 360 degree rotation, 2-way movement, and a retractable hook, this mighty titan tackles tough challenges with ease.

name: Little Chef’s Restaurant
short_description:
A fun-filled restaurant roleplay set for budding chefs!
Now, kids can run their own pretend restaurant by taking orders, preparing dishes and serving food with flair.
From burgers and pies to extruding colourful juices,this Fundough playset has it all!

name: LITTLE FLORIST
short_description:
With our Little Florist DIY kit, you can make flowers with high quality foam, which gives them a soft touch. The foam sheets are easy to work with, making it easy for children to create and assemble bouquets. You can learn to create 16 different types of flowers and over 30 different fun facts about these flowers.
Encourages creativity and cognitive development
The use of the kit encourages one to be creative. Also the entire activity of crafting beautiful flowers gives one a sense of accomplishment.
A thorough guide to create beautiful bouquets
A picture speaks a thousand words. Keeping with this spirit, we have included a number of different pictures taking your little one through the entire journey of crafting the most beautiful flowers
Easy to follow instructions
The instructions provided are easy to follow. We have used images to guide your children through the entire process of making beautiful flowers.

name: Mega Cake Factory
short_description:
Features:
Realistic Cake-Making Fun – Shape, swirl and decorate pretend play cakes with fluffy pretend cream and colourful toppings. 4 Dough Tubs Included – Comes with bright and vibrant Fundough colours for endless creative possibilities. Interactive Playset – Features fun stamping, swirling and sprinkling mechanisms, impression molds for toppings, and exciting cake-themed accessories. Perfect for Young Bakers – Designed for children aged 3 and up, encouraging imaginative play and fine motor skill development. With the Mega Cake Factory, every day is a cake-baking celebration!

name: My First Easel
short_description:
Giggles – My First Easel is a double sided easel which comes with magnetic board and an easel on the other side. It also contains a storage tray which can hold a lot of art materials such as pencils, crayons, markers, chalk of assorted colors, paint brushes and board clips which comes with the set. We also provide magnetic letters (26 nos), Numbers (0-9),operators etc. Its a classic Wooden Easel board with more value !!
The easel comes with a sturdy stand and height-adjustable knobs, allowing it to grow with children. It can be easily customized to suit different ages and provide a comfortable working position

The easel features a double-sided board with a dry erase board that doubles as a magnetic board on one side and a chalkboard on the other, offering multiple surfaces for drawing, writing, and learning activities. This versatility enhances creative and educational play.
The set includes essential accessories such as a paintbrush, 16-inch paper roll for artistic projects, dry erase marker, 1 duster, 2 paper clips, and a tray for holding supplies. This ensures kids have all they need to unleash their creativity.
With 26 magnetic alphabets, 10 magnetic numbers, 5 vowels, and 5 mathematical operations, the easel encourages interactive learning, helping children practice letters, numbers, math, and problem-solving skills while engaging in art projects.

name: RC Beast X
short_description:
Features:
Scale & Dimensions: 1:18 Scale (23 x 16 x 13 cm)
Remote range: Up to – 125 feet+
Running time: Up to 75 minutes
Off-road tyres for rugged surface performance

name: RC Speed X
short_description:
Features:
1:24 Scale (18.5 x 7.6 x 4.2 cm)
Detailed exterior with vibrant, high-quality painting
Runtime of approximately 45-60 minutes on a full charge
Wireless control range of up to ~50 feet

name: RC Vort X
short_description:
Features:
Long Range: Operates over 100ft with 2.4GHz remote
Runtime: 30+ minutes on full charge
360° Spin Stunts – Performs full vertical and horizontal rotations, clockwise and anti-clockwise.
All Wheel Drive (AWD) & Neutral Steering
Dimensions of the car: 16.5 cm × 15.8 cm × 6.35 cm

name: Rummikub Classic
short_description: Rummikub Classic is a fun and engaging numbers game that challenges players to create sets and sequences. Combining luck and strategy, it keeps players thinking and adapting with every move. The goal is to be the first to use all your tiles by forming smart combinations. Perfect for families and friends, it’s easy to learn but endlessly exciting!

name: Scented Glass Candle Kit
short_description: The Funskool Handycrafts Scented Glass Candle Kit is thoughtfully designed for kids aged 8 and above, making candle-making safe, fun, and accessible. Each kit includes all the essentials needed to create three multi-layered glass candles with a delightful vanilla fragrance. The easy-to-follow instructions guide young crafters through the process of layering colorful wax, blending scents, and pouring their creations into glass containers. The end result is a set of vibrant, fragrant candles perfect for birthdays, holidays, or simply adding charm to any space. The kit encourages focus, creativity, and a sense of accomplishment while being entirely safe and easy to use.

name: SCIENCE KIT 1 JUNIOR
short_description: A unique science kit that enables learning theoritical concepts through practical applications, 6 different activities which are made possible due to magnetism.

name: Scotland Yard Junior
short_description: Scotland Yard Junior is a fun and engaging detective game designed for kids aged 6 and up. Players work together to track down the sneaky Mister Fox as he tries to escape through the streets of London. With simplified rules, teamwork, exciting chases, it’s a perfect introduction to strategy games. Easy to learn and full of adventure, it’s a great choice for young detectives!

name: Sequence Classic
short_description:
Sequence is a fun and engaging strategy board game that blends luck and skill. Players use cards to place chips on the board, aiming to create rows of five in a line. The game can be played individually or in teams, making it exciting and competitive. Easy to learn yet full of challenges, Sequence is perfect for family gatherings and game nights.

WHAT’S INSIDE: Comes with a foldable game board, playing cards, and colorful marker chips for up to 12 players everything you need for hours of strategic enjoyment.
BENEFITS: Boosts logical thinking, pattern recognition, planning, and teamwork skills; a fantastic way to develop strategic thinking and patience in both kids and adults.
GIFTING VALUE: A top-selling family favorite for more than 35 years ideal as a present for birthdays, holidays, or game nights with friends and family.
AGE GROUP: Suitable for ages 7 and up; perfect for kids, teens, and adults to enjoy together, whether in teams or individually.
EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER: The straightforward rules make it easy to get started, while the strategic depth keeps the game exciting and challenging every time you play.

name: Shape Sorter Gear Box (Orange)
short_description: Twist, turn, sort and learn! The Giggles Shape Sorter Gear Box is a fun-filled activity cube that helps toddlers explore shapes, textures and movement. With 9 textured shapes to sort through matching slots and 4 turning gears on the lid, it’s a hands-on way to develop motor skills and problem-solving-all in one smart little cube!

name: Solar System Wooden Puzzle 24 Pieces
short_description:
Explore the Solar System!
This fun wooden puzzle from Funskool lets kids discover the planets through hands-on play. With bright illustrations and easy-to-handle pieces, it builds problem-solving skills while making learning exciting. Made from safe, durable wood—perfect for ages 4+ and great for playtime, learning, or gifting.

name: Triominos
short_description:
Triominos is the exciting triangular domino game that adds
strategy and fun to classic tile-matching gameplay.
Connect matching numbers on three sides to score points
and outthink your opponents. Perfect for 2-4 players, it’s
easy to learn but full of depth and strategy. Enjoy endless
hours of family-friendly entertainment with this timeless
game!

name: Unicorn Xylophone
short_description: Introduce your child to the joy of music with this beautifully crafted wooden xylophone. Each brightly coloured bar produces a clear, delightful sound, encouraging creativity and auditory development. Made from durable wood, it’s safe for little hands and built to last. Perfect for sparking a lifelong love of rhythm and music!

name: Wooden Wonderland Playgym
short_description: The Wooden Wonderland Playgym combines premium quality, fun, and safety in a beautifully crafted playgym for your baby. Made from eco-friendly birch plywood, it offers a durable and elegant design that stands out. Its unique three-legged structure ensures maximum stability, while the easy fold-and-unfold mechanism provides hassle-free storage. The soft playmat with adorable animal prints and interactive hanging toys, including a Giraffe, a Cat, and Fruit Teether, encouraging sensory exploration and motor skill development.
